notes: ACCESS: every /shop/ listing page (PLP) is hard-blocked from this workstation this session - m.marshalls.com/us/m/shop/... and www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/... return Akamai 'Something went wrong' (HTTP 403, 37-41KB failover page) on curl_cffi safari18_0_ios, an Akamai bot-manager JS challenge on chrome131, 403 on Googlebot/Googlebot-mobile/Bingbot UAs, 403 on WebFetch, a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge via r.jina.ai, and 403 'Something went wrong' via translate.goog. The non-/shop/ endpoints are open. TREE: taken from Marshalls' own navigation JSON. www.marshalls.com/us/store/xml/siteindex.xml (the sitemap declared in robots.txt) 404s, but the 404 document itself embeds the complete burger-menu navigation in a #burgerMenu-data div, and the same payload is served directly and unprotected at https://m.marshalls.com/us/m/sitewide/json/navMenuData.jsp (robots.txt disallows /us/store/sitewide/ and /us/store/resources/ but not /us/m/..., and names no Claude/anthropic-ai agent). That JSON is a full 1908-node tree carrying an exact itemCount per node - the metric the prior Home-Decor pass confirmed identical to the rendered 'N Items' header on every node where both could be read, and the metric this batch records as exact for TJX/Marshalls Endeca. https://m.marshalls.com/us/m/sitemap.jsp (also open) independently confirms the Home department's child list. QTY: rendered headers were unobtainable, so counts come from that navigation JSON; each count was read three times from three independent responses (the 404 page's burgerMenu-data, navMenuData.jsp?N=239334359, and bare navMenuData.jsp) and was identical every time, and the numbers differ per node (141 / 120 / 167 / 439 / 159 ...) so they are not a site-wide constant. FURNITURE FOUND: the only furniture department in the catalogue is Home > Furniture & Lighting (439), whose children are Chairs & Seating (141), Tables (120) and Lighting (167). Lighting is excluded per the brief. Chairs & Seating and Tables are recorded as leaves - the nav exposes no level below them, and Marshalls' Home tree is only three levels deep. Both were content-verified through the open, unblocked /us/m/swipe/list/_/N-<nValue> deck endpoint, which is category-filtered: N-2342531080 returned swivel counter stools, velvet accent chairs, leather recliners, dining chairs, dining stools, a bed bench, a storage bench and a leather pouf; N-529545536 returned side tables, a console table, a round dining table, a bar cart, nesting table sets and a nightstand. Both are genuinely furniture. EXCLUDED: Lighting (167, out of scope); Home > Outdoor (159) - the nav currently exposes no children under it and the swipe deck for N-239334359 returned planters, outdoor pillows, a wind chime, a pumpkin decoration and a beanbag toss game, i.e. a seasonal outdoor-decor bucket whose primary product type is not furniture, so it was not taken as a furniture leaf; the Outdoor Furniture node that existed earlier in the season (https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/home-home-outdoor-outdoor-furniture/_/N-3487409154, recovered from the search index) is now absent from the navigation and its swipe deck returns zero products, i.e. it is currently empty, so no row was emitted for it. Also excluded: Back to Campus > Furniture & Lighting (98) and Clearance > Furniture & Lighting (52) as seasonal/clearance roll-ups of the same assortment; 'Shop By Room' and 'Shop by Style' as cross-cutting merchandising roll-ups; 'View All' / 'New Arrivals' / 'Clearance' navigation nodes; and the non-furniture Home departments (Bed & Bath, Bedding, Kitchen & Tabletop, Pillows & Decor incl. Baskets & Storage, Luggage & Travel, Pet, Stationery, Fall Decor, Halloween). A keyword sweep of all 1908 nav nodes for furniture terms (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelving, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, vanity, crib, nursery, office, patio) found no furniture anywhere outside Home > Furniture & Lighting - Kids & Baby has no nursery-furniture nodes and there is no office department. LINKS: the mobile nav gives m.marshalls.com/us/m/shop/<slug>/_/N-<nValue>; the desktop canonical is www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/<slug>/_/N-<nValue>, the shape the prior pass verified on this same parent (home-home-furniture-lighting-lighting/_/N-3918041668). Canonical desktop URLs are recorded.
